# laravelcloud_bucket (Data Source)

Reads an existing Laravel Cloud bucket by ID. Useful when composing modules that reference a shared object-store bucket provisioned in a separate state OR via the Cloud dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads an existing Laravel Cloud bucket by ID.

data "laravelcloud_bucket" "uploads_prd" {
  id = "buk_01HAM..."
}

output "uploads_prd_mode" {
  value = data.laravelcloud_bucket.uploads_prd.mode
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cloud-assigned bucket ID (ULID).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of bucket creation.
- `mode` (String) Access mode — `private` or `public`.
- `name` (String) Bucket name (globally unique within Cloud).
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the owning Cloud organisation.
- `region` (String) Deploy region.
- `status` (String) Cloud lifecycle status.
